basic_profile.bio: A passionate Tennessee Titans fan and a fragrance enthusiast, I've been on Reddit for over six years. Living in Nashville, I work as a data analyst during the day and dive into the intricacies of NFL strategies by night. I enjoy discussing tactical decisions in football, especially defensive plays, and I'm always up for a good debate. My weekends are usually spent hiking in the Smoky Mountains or catching up on the latest anime series. I'm currently single and spend most evenings online, especially after 8 PM, participating in discussions on various subreddits.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Sports Management, I have a deep understanding of football strategies and player statistics. My expertise is further enriched by years of self-study and following the NFL closely. I also have a keen interest in fragrances, having explored countless brands and notes over the years.
